sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 3XL.
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 4XL+ when performing a critical hit.
Restores 5% of damage dealt as HP.
Ability Power scales with the number of Light elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 5XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Light elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
